spans.s:
रौम n. (-मं) A sort of salt; see the next.
 E. रुम the place where it is found, अण् aff.

रौमक n. (-कं) A kind of salt, according to some authorities, brought
from a mountain in AJMERE, but in fact produced from a salt lake
near the town of SĀMBHAR, about twenty miles west of JAYANA-
GAR.
 E. रुम the district of RUMA or SĀMBHAR, aff. अण्, and कन्
added; also रौम and रौमलवण ।

रौमलवण n. (-णं) Sāmbher-salt; see the last.
 E. रौम as above, and लवण salt.
